verdict.rationale: Tailscale ships Tailscale SSH (docs-26), so a question about SSH-based file transfer fairly applies to it. However, nothing in the evidence documents scp or sftp transfers, or the use of user-configured SSH keys. Taildrop-style file sending between devices (docs-23) is a different feature and earns no credit for this story.

support.subject: As a developer, I can transfer files to and from remote hosts via scp and sftp using my configured keys
